Kit summary

Swift Skyward SwordBasic
Deals 160% DEF DMG and 160% DEF [Internal Injury] DMG to a single enemy, and inflicts 1 layer of [Cracked Blade] on the enemy for 3 turns ([Cracked Blade]: Up to 3 layers can be owned, each reducing the owner's Direct DMG and DoT dealt by 15%).
Sword GuardianActive
Grants [Spirit of Sword] on all allies for 4 turns and [Stealth] on all allies (excluding self) for 2 turns. Targets with [Spirit of Sword]: 1. Reduces Basic Attack DMG and Skill DMG taken by 50%. 2. When HP is below 60% for the first time, restores HP equal to the same amount of HP restored by Sacred Heart Sutra while having [Life Barrier] and inflicts [Cracked Blade] on all enemies for 3 turns.
Sacred Heart SutraPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2
All the DMG dealt by Murong Jing is calculated based on DEF. When a battle starts, Murong Jing gains [Life Barrier] for 9 turns. While having [Life Barrier], Murong Jing is immune to Control effects, and restores HP equal to (170%+2.7*self Leech) *self DEF (up to 70% Leech can be calculated, not affected by Healing Effect or Healed Effect) for all allies at the beginning of each turn. The restoration effect will be reduced to 50% of the original after [Life Barrier] ends. For every 1 turn of [Life Barrier]'s duration reduced, Murong Jing gains 1 layer of [Will of Sword], increasing self Mastery by 20%.
Darksteel Skyward Sword Lv.1Additionally increases self Leech by 30%. Each time the restoration effect of Sacred Heart Sutra is triggered while [Life Barrier] is owned, cleanses 1 layer of debuffs from the target. Also, at the beginning of others' turns, if there is any ally with HP below 80% on the battlefield, triggers Sacred Heart Sutra's HP restoration effect once immediately. This effect can be triggered up to 4 times and the chances to trigger it will be reset after Murong Jing's turn ends.
Darksteel Skyward Sword Lv.2At the beginning of each wave, grants all allies [Spirit of Sword] for 2 turns. Also, the triggered effect will be enhanced when HP of the target with [Spirit of Sword] is below 60% for the first time: restores HP equal to 200% of the HP restored by Sacred Heart Sutra while [Life Barrier] is owned, additionally reduces the target's Basic Attack DMG and Skill DMG taken by 30% for 2 turns, and inflicts 2 layers of [Cracked Blade] on all enemies for 3 turns.
Uniting of Myriad SwordsActiveExclusive Lv.3
Deals 3 stages of 100% DEF [Internal Injury] DMG each to all enemies, each having a 100% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Internal Injury] on the target for 2 turns. Once the skill deals DMG, restores self HP based on self Leech (not affected by Healed Effect and Healing Effect); meanwhile, if self is over-healed after the HP Restoration effect, inflicts HP Deduction effect equal to 50% of the over-healed part on the target, caps at 35% of the skill's DMG dealt and this effect can reduce the target's HP to less than 1.
Darksteel Skyward Sword Lv.3After Murong Jing deals DMG proactively, for every 1 layer of [Will of Sword] owned by self, deals 150% DEF [Internal Injury] DMG to a random enemy once (considered as Skill DMG and increases DMG dealt to 200% of the original if the target is a boss). Also, each stage of Uniting of Myriad Swords inflicts 1 layer of [Cracked Blade] on the target and removes 1 layer of buffs from them. The HP Deduction effect caused by Uniting of Myriad Swords will be equal to the over-healed part, caps at 70% of Uniting of Myriad Swords's DMG dealt.
